title: Percentage Change Calculator
h1: Percentage Change Calculator — Increase or Decrease
seoTitle: Free Percentage Change Calculator — % Increase Decrease
description: Calculate the percentage increase or decrease between two values. Shows absolute change and percentage change instantly in your browser.
intro: Enter the original and new values to see how much a number has grown or shrunk as a percentage.
blurb: Compute percentage increase or decrease between two numbers.
howItWorks: Enter the starting (original) value and the ending (new) value.
Click Calculate or change the numbers.
See the percentage change, absolute difference, and whether it increased or decreased.
examples: Useful for tracking price changes, growth, or score improvements.

faq.q: What is the formula for percentage change?
faq.a: ((New − Old) / |Old|) × 100. A positive result means increase; negative means decrease.

faq.q: What if the original value is zero?
faq.a: Percentage change from zero is undefined. The tool will show a message instead of a number.
No. All calculations happen locally in your browser.
